sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def get_player_pos():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels'] == 24:
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rows), min(cols))
    return None

pos = get_player_pos()
print(f"Current: {pos}")

# Test all 4 directions
for direction in ['UP', 'DOWN', 'LEFT', 'RIGHT']:
    result = action([direction])
    new_pos = get_player_pos()
    moved = new_pos != pos
    no_impact = last_action_result.get('no_impact')
    gameplay = last_action_result.get('gameplay_changed')
    print(f"{direction}: {pos} -> {new_pos}, moved={moved}, no_impact={no_impact}, gameplay={gameplay}")
    if moved:
        pos = new_pos
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
